stem:
Kavya churns a bowl of fresh curd with a hand churner. Fatty lumps gather, and a thin liquid remains.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The fatty lumps obtained by churning the curd are butter.
The fatty lumps obtained by churning the curd are buttermilk.
Churning is a suitable method to obtain butter from curd.
The thin liquid left after churning is butter.

teacher.key_rationale: Churning separates butter as fatty lumps from curd; the remaining liquid is buttermilk, not butter. Swapping the names of the lumps and the liquid is the common mix-up.
